description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). Open a position on an Event Card's index for YOUR linked platform account. Defaults to PAPER trading (no real funds move — positions and P&L are tracked and tagged paper). Live trading only on an explicit paper=false AND the platform trading gate. direction 'bull' profits when the card index rises, 'bear' when it falls.

card_name.description: Alternative to card_id: the card's display name.

confirmation_token.description: Required when paper=false: single-use confirmation token proving the linked user approved a real-money trade.

direction.description: bull = long the index, bear = short it

paper.description: true (DEFAULT) = paper trade, no funds move. false = live trade, gated by the platform trading gate.

name: trade_event_card
title: Trade Event Card
